chapter_seo_title: I Eat Tomatoes Returns: A Family Hiatus & New Desolate Era Update Schedule
chapter_meta_description: I Eat Tomatoes apologizes for the Desolate Era hiatus, sharing the story of his infant son's hospitalization. He announces a new 12-chapter weekly schedule inspired by Swallowing the Starry Sky.
og_title: Behind the Scenes: Tomato’s Family Hiatus & Schedule Update
og_description: The author of Desolate Era opens up about a family health crisis, recovery, and a return to a 12-chapter weekly routine.
twitter_title: Tomato’s Hiatus Story: Family, Hospitals & New Update News
twitter_description: I Eat Tomatoes explains his absence from Desolate Era due to his baby’s hospitalization. A heartfelt note followed by a new update schedule.

lore_anchors.definition: The pen name of the author of *Desolate Era*; a renowned Chinese web novel writer.
A previous hit science-fiction/cultivation novel by I Eat Tomatoes, used here as a benchmark for his new update pace.
The author's affectionate nickname for his three-month-old son.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did the author miss days of updates?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His three-month-old son became ill and required hospitalization; the author and his family spent several days at the hospital caring for the baby.
Many readers were concerned about the author's health, but here he clarifies that it was his child who was ill; he has a history of kidney stones but downplays that as a manageable condition.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the new update schedule?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Starting August 2nd, Tomato will post one chapter on Fridays and Saturdays, and two chapters on the other five days of the week, totaling 12 chapters per week — the same pace as his earlier novel *Swallowing the Starry Sky*.
